d:
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko bhavy banane ke lie 10 bighe men shahi pandal taiyar ho raha hai. mukhy pandal tajamhal aur dusra lal kile ki tarj par banaya jaega. iske lie yupi ke maoo se aae karigar din-rat jute hain. vahin, VIP mehmanon ke helikoptar se pahunchne ke lie chhah se adhik helipaid bhi banae ja rahe hain.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
